safety_verdicts.content: Patient developed lower abdominal/suprapubic pain 2 days ago with a gradual onset.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes lower abdominal pain starting ~2 days ago, but does not state the onset was gradual.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether pain onset was sudden vs gradual can influence the differential (e.g., acute surgical/gynecologic causes versus evolving infection/functional pain) and urgency of escalation. Omission mainly reduces clinical clarity and may affect triage rather than directly causing harm.
